description: Limited rollout: only for a use ticket from a pattern, starter or formation read. If you have no ticket, do not call it. With one, report once after your task: `worked`, `partly` or `did_not_work`, with an optional short note. The response returns a useful follow-up from indexed content when one exists. No prompt, code or log is stored. Terms: /docs/api/contributing.md.
name: report_outcome
title: Report a use ticket outcome
